ws_email_rules_001.title: Classification Rules
values: Body contains action keywords (approve, sign, submit, complete by)
Please approve the budget by Friday
Body contains urgency indicators (urgent, asap, immediately, critical)
Body contains deadline within 7 days of current date
Mark as read + apply PROCESSED-FYI label
Note: Security-related emails should always receive manual review
After processing, email ops-inbox@company.example.com with subject 'VIP Email Processing Complete'. Include count of emails processed and count left unread.
